cadenceBasis.observed: data.gouv.fr states frequency «daily»; the GTFS resource was last modified 2026-10-20 (read 2026-11-21). The bundle holds a 14-day window (WINDOW_DAYS), so it is rebuilt every three days: the window never has fewer than 11 days left, and a date beyond it is refused (js/transit-raptor.js coverage)
cadenceBasis.expires: if the publisher moves to a different schedule, or WINDOW_DAYS changes

autoRefresh: one dataset-API request (www.data.gouv.fr) and one archive download, no key; the dataset licence is re-read and the build refuses any change from lov2; the archive must contain a calendar covering a day from today on, and nothing is written when any of that fails
